body:
## What

Phase 1 of `openspec/changes/add-admiral-agency`: the Admiral pane.

- `agency.db` and its IPC: jobs, questions, wakeups with a lease, lobby and job threads.
- Admiral engine mode: scoped tools, fenced data, mid-turn inbox, `ask_client` and `job_open`.
- Admiral runtime and pane UI: lobby, job tabs, job sheet, question cards, handoff from lobby to job.
- Onboarding: first run, project picker, setup, starter questions, and project switcher.
- One Admiral per repo, claimed in main and tied to the window.
- Review and E2E fixes (see the last commit).

All Phase 1 tasks in `tasks.md` are ticked.

## Tests

- `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` (4446 tests) pass.
- Real-model E2E in the dev app: first run, setup, brief, question card, answer, wakeup, job open, handoff.
